data.notes: Every Hyperliquid perp's momentum score and the long-short momentum factor's returns, method momentum/1 (lookback required: 7d or 14d, winners minus losers). factors/momentum is one hour's reading (at, default now): every perp with 60 days of history and dollar volume in the 30 days before the universe pick, its lookback return, 30-day hourly volatility, score (return over volatility), pct_rank, quintile and whether it is in the top-25 and top-50 universes. factors/momentum/returns is the factor's return per 1h or 1d bucket on the top 25 or top 50 perps by 30-day dollar volume (every perp ever listed, delisted ones included, re-picked every 30 days): long the top fifth on the score, short the bottom fifth, inverse-volatility weighted, rebalanced Saturdays 00:00 UTC, gross of fees and funding; holdings=true adds the weights. Both from 2025-05-24 01:00 UTC.

note: data keeps only the momentum row of the 105 rows the API returned; meta.count is the recorded count
